name: Single Leg Plate Hop
instructions: Place a weight plate on the floor and stand on one foot beside it.
Hop sideways over the plate and land softly on the same foot.
Keep your knee aligned over your toes.
longevityNotes: Cardiovascular fitness is the single strongest predictor of a long, active life. Regular cardio work keeps the heart, lungs, and brain in shape for decades.
overview: A single-leg hop over or onto a plate that builds ankle stiffness and single-leg power.

sources.title: Original to the LIFT knowledge base

attribution: Original prose written for the LIFT knowledge base (CC BY 4.0).
safetyNotes: Use a flat plate on a non-slip surface; skip with ankle instability.
